ActiveFlowLog.description_en: Enables a flow log. After the flow log is enabled, the system collects traffic information about a specified resource
ActiveFlowLog.description_zh: 启动流日志，启动后开始捕获指定资源的流量

AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolic.description_en: Adds a traffic classification rule to a traffic marking policy
AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolic.description_zh: 调用AddTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy接口为流量标记策略添加流分类规则

AddTraficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_en: Adds a traffic classification rule to a traffic marking policy
AddTraficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_zh: 为流量标记策略添加流分类规则

AssociateCenBandwidthPackage.description_en: Attaches a bandwidth plan to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
AssociateCenBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 将带宽包实例绑定至云企业网实例

AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: Associates the vSwitch of a virtual private cloud (VPC) with a multicast domain
AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_zh: 为了VPC下的资源可以实现组播通信，调用AssociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口将专有网络（VPC）下的交换机（VSwitch）关联到组播域中

AttachCenChildInstance.description_en: Attaches a network instance to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
AttachCenChildInstance.description_zh: 调用AttachCenChildInstance接口将网络实例加载到云企业网实例中

CheckTransitRouterService.description_en: Queries whether your Alibaba Cloud account has the transit router feature activated
CheckTransitRouterService.description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号是否已开通转发路由器服务

CreateCen.description_en: A Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance is the fundamental resource for managing an integrated network. A CEN instance manages one network and can span one or more regions. Before enabling connectivity between network instances, call the CreateCen operation to create a CEN instance
CreateCen.description_zh: 云企业网实例是管理一体化网络的基础资源。一个云企业网实例管理一张网络，可覆盖一个或多个地域。在实现网络实例互通前，您需要先调用CreateCen接口创建一个云企业网实例

CreateCenBandwidthPackage.description_en: Creates a bandwidth plan for Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) to enable cross-region connectivity between network instances
CreateCenBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 要实现跨地域网络实例互通，您必须购买带宽包。您可以调用CreateCenBandwidthPackage接口创建带宽包

CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.description_en: You can call the CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttachment operation to create a route for a network instance connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router. The next hop of the route points to the transit router in the current region
CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.description_zh: 在企业版转发路由器中，您可以调用CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttachment接口为网络实例添加路由条目，目标网段的下一跳指向当前地域的转发路由器

CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.description_en: Adds routes to a network instance
CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.description_zh: 调用CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen接口为网络实例添加路由条目

CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.description_en: Creates a quality of service (QoS) policy for an inter-region connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router
CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.description_zh: 如果您需要优化和控制跨区域的网络流量，您可以调用CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy接口创建企业版转发路由器下的跨地域流量调度策略

CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.description_en: Creates queues in a quality of service (QoS) policy to manage network traffic based on finer granularities, improve service performance, and meet service-level agreements (SLAs)
CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.description_zh: 如果您需要对不同类型和优先级的网络流量进行细致管理，以确保关键业务流量的性能并遵守服务级别协议，您可以调用CreateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue接口创建流量调度策略下队列的配置

CreateCenRouteMap.description_en: Creates a routing policy. A routing policy filters routing information and facilitates network management
CreateCenRouteMap.description_zh: 通过路由策略功能，可以过滤路由信息，帮助您自定义管理云上网络互通能力，您可以调用CreateCenRouteMap接口创建路由策略

CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_en: Creates a traffic marking policy. A traffic marking policy captures network traffic based on traffic classification rules and marks the traffic with the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) values that you specify
CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_zh: 流量标记策略通过流分类规则捕获符合规则的流量，捕获后，您可以为流量添加DSCP（Differentiated Services Code Point）值作为标记。您可以通过调用CreateTrafficMarkingPolicy创建流量标记策略

CreateTransitRouter.description_en: Creates an Enterprise Edition transit router instance
CreateTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouter接口创建企业版转发路由器实例

CreateTransitRouterCidr.description_en: A transit router CIDR block is a custom CIDR block that you can create for a transit router. This CIDR block is similar to a CIDR block that is used to assign an IP address to a router's loopback interface. Call the CreateTransitRouterCidr operation to create a CIDR block for a transit router
CreateTransitRouterCidr.description_zh: 转发路由器地址段是您为转发路由器自定义的一个地址段，该地址段类似于为路由器环回口（Loopback接口）分配IP地址的地址段。您可以调用CreateTransitRouterCidr接口创建转发路由器下CIDR地址段

CreateTransitRouterEcrAttachment.description_en: Creates a connection between an Express Connect Router (ECR) instance and a transit router instance in the same region
CreateTransitRouterEcrAttachment.description_zh: 您可以调用CreateTransitRouterEcrAttachment接口将要互通的专线网关ECR（ExpressConnect Router）网络实例连接到同地域的转发路由器实例中

CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: A multicast domain defines the scope of a multicast network within a region. Only resources within the multicast domain can send and receive multicast traffic. Resources outside the multicast domain cannot send or receive multicast traffic. You can call the CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation to create a multicast domain
CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_zh: 组播域是在地域范围内定义一个组播网络的范围，只有组播域之内的资源可以发送和接收组播流量，组播域之外的资源无法发送和接收组播流量，您可以调用CreateTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口创建组播域

CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment.description_en: Creates an inter-region connection for an Enterprise Edition transit router instance
CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment.description_zh: 网络实例（VPC、VBR、IPsec连接）被连接至转发路由器后，如果要实现不同地域网络实例的互通，需要在网络实例连接的转发路由器下创建跨地域连接，您可以调用CreateTransitRouterPeerAttachment接口为企业版转发路由器实例创建跨地域连接

CreateTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_en: Associates the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router with a prefix list
CreateTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_zh: 为企业版转发路由器路由表绑定前缀列表

CreateTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_en: Creates a route entry in the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
CreateTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_zh: 在企业版转发路由器的路由表中添加路由条目

CreateTransitRouterRouteTable.description_en: Calls the CreateTransitRouterRouteTable operation to create a custom route table for an Enterprise Edition transit router
CreateTransitRouterRouteTable.description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouterRouteTable接口为企业版转发路由器创建自定义路由表

CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment.description_en: Invokes the CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment operation to connect a Virtual Border Router (VBR) network instance to a transit router instance in the same region. After the connection is established, the transit router can help you achieve private network peering
CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment.description_zh: 您可以调用CreateTransitRouterVbrAttachment接口将要互通的边界路由器VBR（Virtual Border Router）网络实例连接到同地域的转发路由器实例中。连接后，转发路由器可帮您实现私网互通

CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment.description_en: Calls the CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment operation to connect a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) instance to a transit router instance for private network peering. After the connection is established, the transit router instance can help you achieve private network peering
CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment.description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment接口将要互通的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）实例连接至转发路由器实例。连接后，转发路由器实例可以帮助您实现私网互通

CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment.description_en: Creates a VPN attachment on a transit router. Transit routers support connections to IPsec-VPN connections of VPN gateways. An on-premises data center can connect to a transit router through an IPsec-VPN connection and then communicate with other networks through the transit router
CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment.description_zh: 转发路由器支持连接VPN网关的IPsec连接。本地数据中心可以通过IPsec连接直接连接至转发路由器，然后通过转发路由器实现与其他网络的互通，调用CreateTransitRouterVpnAttachment接口创建VPN连接

DeactiveFlowLog.description_en: Disables a flow log. A disabled flow log no longer captures network traffic
DeactiveFlowLog.description_zh: 停止流日志，停止后不再捕获指定资源的流量

DeleteCen.description_en: Deletes a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DeleteCen.description_zh: 调用DeleteCen接口删除云企业网实例

DeleteCenBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenBandwidthPackage接口删除带宽包实例

DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.description_en: Call the DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttachment operation to delete a route entry from a network instance that is connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttach.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器连接的网络实例的路由条目

DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.description_en: You can call the DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen operation to delete a route from a network instance
DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen接口删除网络实例下的路由条目

DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.description_en: Deletes a quality of service (QoS) policy
DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicy接口删除流量调度策略

DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.description_en: Deletes a queue from a quality of service (QoS) policy
DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueue接口删除流量调度策略下的队列

DeleteCenRouteMap.description_en: The DeleteCenRouteMap operation deletes a specified routing policy
DeleteCenRouteMap.description_zh: 调用DeleteCenRouteMap接口删除指定的路由策略

DeleteRouteServiceInCen.description_en: Call the DeleteRouteServiceInCen operation to delete the configuration of an Alibaba Cloud service from a Basic Edition transit router
DeleteRouteServiceInCen.description_zh: 调用DeleteRouteServiceInCen接口删除基础版转发路由器云服务配置

DeleteTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_en: Deletes a specified traffic marking policy
DeleteTrafficMarkingPolicy.description_zh: 调用DeleteTrafficMarkingPolicy接口删除流量标记策略

DeleteTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouter接口删除企业版转发路由器实例

DeleteTransitRouterCidr.description_en: Deletes a CIDR block from a transit router
DeleteTransitRouterCidr.description_zh: 删除转发路由器下CIDR地址段

DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment.description_en: Deletes an Express Connect Router (ECR) connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterEcrAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器下的专线网关ECR（ExpressConnect Router）连接

DeleteTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: You can call the DeleteTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation to delete a multicast domain

DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment.description_en: Call the DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment operation to delete an inter-region connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterPeerAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器下的跨地域连接

DeleteTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_en: Disassociates the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router from a prefix list
DeleteTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_zh: 解除企业版转发路由器路由表与前缀列表的绑定关系

DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_en: You can call the DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry operation to delete a static route of the Blackhole or Attachment type from the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterRouteEntry接口删除企业版转发路由器路由表中黑洞、连接实例类型的静态配置路由条目

DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable.description_en: You can call the DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable operation to delete a custom route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterRouteTable接口删除企业版转发路由器的自定义路由表

DeleteTransitRouterVbrAttachment.description_en: Deletes a virtual border router (VBR) connection for an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterVbrAttachment.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterVbrAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器下的边界路由器VBR（Virtual border router）连接

DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment.description_en: Deletes a virtual private cloud (VPC) connection from an Enterprise Edition transit router
DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment.description_zh: 调用DeleteTransitRouterVpcAttachment接口删除企业版转发路由器下的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接

DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMem.description_en: If a multicast member no longer needs to receive multicast traffic, you can call the DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers operation to delete the member from the multicast group
DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMem.description_zh: 如果您不需要某个组播成员再接收组播流量，您可以调用DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers接口将该组播成员从组播组中删除

DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSou.description_en: If a multicast source no longer needs to send multicast traffic, you can call the DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources operation to remove the multicast source from the multicast group
DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSou.description_zh: 如果您不需要某个组播源再发送组播流量，您可以调用DeregisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources接口将该组播源从组播组中删除

DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribut.description_en: Queries the information about a network instance, such as a virtual private cloud (VPC), a virtual border router, or a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance, that is attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribut.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenAttachedChildInstanceAttribute接口查看加载到CEN中的网络实例（VPC、VBR、CCN）的网络实例的加载状态、网络实例的类型等详细信息

DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances.description_en: Queries the network instances that are attached to a CEN instance
DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenAttachedChildInstances接口查询云企业网实例下已加载的网络实例信息

DescribeCenBandwidthPackages.description_en: Queries the information about bandwidth plans
DescribeCenBandwidthPackages.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenBandwidthPackages接口查询带宽包实例的信息

DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries.description_en: Queries the routes of a network instance that is attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenChildInstanceRouteEntries接口查询云企业网中网络实例的路由条目信息

DescribeCenGeographicSpanRemainingBandwi.description_en: Queries the remaining bandwidth of a specified bandwidth plan
DescribeCenGeographicSpanRemainingBandwi.description_zh: 查询指定带宽包实例的剩余带宽值

DescribeCenGeographicSpans.description_en: You can call the DescribeCenGeographicSpans operation to query the connected areas supported by Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
DescribeCenGeographicSpans.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenGeographicSpans接口查询云企业网支持的互通区域的信息

DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits.description_en: Call the DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits operation to query the bandwidth limits for inter-region communication
DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenInterRegionBandwidthLimits接口查询各个地域之间的跨地域互通带宽的信息

DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes.description_en: Queries the PrivateZone service configurations of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenPrivateZoneRoutes接口查询云企业网实例的PrivateZone服务配置信息

DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries.description_en: Queries the details of route entries in a specific region of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenRegionDomainRouteEntries接口查询云企业网实例中具体地域内路由条目的详细信息

DescribeCenRouteMaps.description_en: You can call the DescribeCenRouteMaps operation to query the configurations of routing policies
DescribeCenRouteMaps.description_zh: 调用DescribeCenRouteMaps接口查询路由策略中已配置信息

DescribeCenVbrHealthCheck.description_en: Queries the health check information for a virtual border router (VBR) in a specified region
DescribeCenVbrHealthCheck.description_zh: 查询指定地域内边界路由器（VBR）健康检查信息

DescribeCens.description_en: You can call the DescribeCens operation to query information about Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instances that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account. This information includes the status of the instances, whether IPv6 is enabled, and a list of attached bandwidth plans
DescribeCens.description_zh: 调用DescribeCens接口查询当前阿里云账号下的云企业网实例的状态、是否已开启IPv6功能、实例绑定的带宽包的列表等信息

DescribeChildInstanceRegions.description_en: You can call the DescribeChildInstanceRegions operation to query the regions where you can attach network instances to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeChildInstanceRegions.description_zh: 调用DescribeChildInstanceRegions接口查询云企业网支持加载网络实例的地域信息

DescribeGeographicRegionMembership.description_zh: 查询指定区域内的地域信息

DescribeGrantRulesToCen.description_en: Queries the cross-account network instances that have been authorized for a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
DescribeGrantRulesToCen.description_zh: 调用DescribeGrantRulesToCen接口查询云企业网实例已获得授权的跨账号的网络实例的信息

DescribeGrantRulesToResource.description_en: Queries the permissions that a network instance has on a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance owned by another Alibaba Cloud account. This operation returns details such as the main account that owns the CEN instance and the payer for the network instance
DescribeGrantRulesToResource.description_zh: 调用DescribeGrantRulesToResource接口查询网络实例对跨账号云企业网实例的授权信息，包括云企业网实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）、网络实例的付费方等信息

DescribePublishedRouteEntries.description_en: Queries whether the routes of virtual private clouds (VPCs) and virtual border routers (VBRs) are advertised to the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the VCPs and VBRs are attached, the instance type of the next hop of each route, and whether advertised routes can be withdrawn
DescribePublishedRouteEntries.description_zh: 您可以调用DescribePublishedRouteEntries接口查询已加载到CEN网络实例（VPC和VBR）的各条路由在CEN中的发布状态、路由条目下一跳关联的实例类型、是否允许发布或撤销该路由到云企业网等信息

DescribeRouteConflict.description_en: The DescribeRouteConflict operation queries conflicting routes in a network instance
DescribeRouteConflict.description_zh: 调用DescribeRouteConflict接口查询网络实例中存在冲突的路由条目信息

DescribeRouteServicesInCen.description_en: Queries the configurations of Alibaba Cloud services that are configured in a Basic Edition transit router
DescribeRouteServicesInCen.description_zh: 调用DescribeRouteServicesInCen接口查询基础版转发路由器下的云服务配置信息

DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation.description_en: Queries the aggregate routes in the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregation.description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表下的聚合路由

DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregationDeta.description_en: Queries the configuration details of a specified aggregate route
DescribeTransitRouteTableAggregationDeta.description_zh: 查询指定聚合路由的配置详情

DetachCenChildInstance.description_en: Detaches a network instance from a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) transit router
DetachCenChildInstance.description_zh: 调用DetachCenChildInstance接口卸载云企业网实例中的网络实例

DisableCenVbrHealthCheck.description_en: Disables the health check feature for a virtual border router (VBR)
DisableCenVbrHealthCheck.description_zh: 关闭指定边界路由器（VBR）的健康检查

DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: Call the DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain operation to dissociate a vSwitch from a multicast domain
DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_zh: 调用DisassociateTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口解除交换机与组播域的关联关系

DissociateTransitRouterAttachmentFromRou.description_en: Dissociates a network instance connection from a route table

EnableCenVbrHealthCheck.description_en: Enables the health check feature for a virtual border router (VBR) or modifies the health check configuration of a VBR. Health checks help you promptly detect faulty Express Connect circuits
EnableCenVbrHealthCheck.description_zh: 开启边界路由器（VBR）的健康检查功能，确保及时发现出现故障的物理专线，也可修改VBR的健康检查配置

GrantInstanceToTransitRouter.description_en: Grants a transit router permissions on network instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account. To connect a transit router of Account B to a network instance of Account A, you must use Account A to grant permissions to the transit router of Account B
GrantInstanceToTransitRouter.description_zh: 在转发路由器实例连接其他账号的网络实例前，需要其他账号的网络实例对转发路由器实例进行授权。调用GrantInstanceToTransitRouter接口为转发路由器实例进行授权

ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttach.description_en: Queries the routes that point to a network instance connection. The routes are retrieved from the route table of a network instance that is attached to an Enterprise Edition transit router
ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttach.description_zh: 调用ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttachment接口查询企业版转发路由器下网络实例路由表中指向网络实例连接的路由条目

ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies.description_en: You can call the ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies operation to query Quality of Service (QoS) policies
ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies.description_zh: 调用ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicies接口查询流量调度策略的信息

ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues.description_en: Queries the queues of a Quality of Service (QoS) policy
ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues.description_zh: 调用ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues接口查询流量调度策略队列的信息

ListGrantVSwitchEnis.description_en: You can call the ListGrantVSwitchEnis operation to query which elastic network interfaces (ENIs) in a virtual private cloud (VPC) can serve as multicast sources or members
ListGrantVSwitchEnis.description_zh: 调用ListGrantVSwitchEnis接口查询在一个专有网络内部，哪些弹性网卡的配置可以成为组播源或者组播成员用来进行组播通信

ListGrantVSwitchesToCen.description_en: You can call the ListGrantVSwitchesToCen operation to query vSwitches in a cross-account VPC that is connected to a CEN instance
ListGrantVSwitchesToCen.description_zh: 调用ListGrantVSwitchesToCen接口查询云企业网实例已连接的跨账号专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）下交换机的信息

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are attached to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询云企业网实例绑定的标签信息

ListTrafficMarkingPolicies.description_en: You can call the ListTrafficMarkingPolicies operation to query details about traffic marking policies, such as their status and priority
ListTrafficMarkingPolicies.description_zh: 调用ListTrafficMarkingPolicies接口查询流量标记策略的状态、流量标记策略的优先级等详细信息

ListTransitRouterAvailableResource.description_en: Queries the zones that are available for an Enterprise Edition transit router in a specified region
ListTransitRouterAvailableResource.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterAvailableResource接口查询指定地域下企业版转发路由器支持的可用区信息

ListTransitRouterCidr.description_en: Queries the CIDR blocks of a transit router
ListTransitRouterCidr.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterCidr接口查询转发路由器下CIDR地址段的信息

ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation.description_en: Queries the allocation details of a CIDR block
ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterCidrAllocation接口查询CIDR地址段的分配信息

ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments.description_en: Queries the information about Express Connect Router (ECR) connections on an Enterprise Edition transit router, such as the connection status, connection ID, and the payer of instance fees
ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterEcrAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下的专线网关ECR总条目数、连接的状态、连接 ID、网络实例的付费方等连接信息

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociat.description_en: You can call the ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociations operation to query the associations between multicast domains and vSwitches
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociat.description_zh: 您可以调用ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainAssociations接口查询组播域和交换机的关联关系

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitche.description_en: After a VPC instance is connected to an Enterprise Edition transit router, you can call the ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitches operation to query information about vSwitches that are attached to multicast domains in the virtual private cloud (VPC) instance
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitche.description_zh: VPC实例连接至企业版转发路由器后，您可以调用ListTransitRouterMulticastDomainVSwitches接口查询VPC实例下已绑定组播域的交换机的信息

ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains.description_en: Call the ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains operation to query information about multicast domains, such as their statuses, IDs, and descriptions
ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterMulticastDomains接口查询组播域的状态、组播域ID、组播域的描述等信息

ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups.description_en: Queries details about multicast members and sources in a multicast domain
ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups接口查询组播域下组播成员和组播源的详细信息

ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments.description_en: Call the ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments operation to query details about the inter-region connections of an Enterprise Edition transit router
ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterPeerAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下的跨地域连接的详细信息

ListTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_en: Queries the prefix list associations for the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
ListTransitRouterPrefixListAssociation.description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表绑定的前缀列表的信息

ListTransitRouterRouteEntries.description_en: Queries the details about routes in the route tables of an Enterprise Edition transit router
ListTransitRouterRouteEntries.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterRouteEntries接口查询企业版转发路由器路由表中的路由条目的详细信息

ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations.description_en: Call the ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations operation to query the forwarding associations for a route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router or for a network instance connection
ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterRouteTableAssociations接口查询企业版转发路由器路由表或网络实例连接已创建的关联转发关系

ListTransitRouterRouteTablePropagations.description_en: Lists the route propagations for the route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
ListTransitRouterRouteTablePropagations.description_zh: 查询企业版转发路由器路由表的路由学习关系

ListTransitRouterRouteTables.description_en: Call the ListTransitRouterRouteTables operation to query the route tables associated with an Enterprise Edition transit router
ListTransitRouterRouteTables.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterRouteTables接口查询企业版转发路由器的路由表的详细信息

ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments.description_en: Queries information about virtual border router (VBR) connections for an Enterprise Edition transit router. The returned information includes the total number of connections, connection status, connection ID, and the payer for the network instance
ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterVbrAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下的边界路由器VBR总条目数、连接的状态、连接 ID、网络实例的付费方等连接信息

ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments.description_en: Queries details about virtual private cloud (VPC) connections on an Enterprise Edition transit router, including the connection status, billing method, and zone, as well as the vSwitches and elastic network interfaces (ENIs) of the connected VPC
ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterVpcAttachments接口查询企业版转发路由器下专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）VPC连接的状态、VPC连接的付费类型、VPC连接的可用区信息及其关联的VPC实例的交换机和弹性网卡信息等

ListTransitRouterVpnAttachments.description_en: You can call the ListTransitRouterVpnAttachments operation to query information about VPN connections, such as their status, IPsec-VPN connection ID, and billing method
ListTransitRouterVpnAttachments.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterVpnAttachment接口查询VPN连接的状态、IPsec连接ID、VPN连接的付费类型等信息

ListTransitRouters.description_en: You can call the ListTransitRouters operation to query information about transit routers in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, such as the instance type, status, instance ID, and whether the multicast feature is enabled
ListTransitRouters.description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouters接口查询云企业网实例下转发路由器实例的实例类型、实例的状态、转发路由器实例ID、是否开启了组播功能等信息

ModifyCenAttribute.description_en: The ModifyCenAttribute operation modifies the name and description of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
ModifyCenAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyCenAttribute接口修改云企业网实例的名称和描述信息

ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute.description_en: You can call the ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute operation to modify the name and description of a bandwidth plan
ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyCenBandwidthPackageAttribute接口修改带宽包实例的名称和描述信息

ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec.description_en: Modifies the maximum bandwidth of a bandwidth plan
ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec.description_zh: 调用ModifyCenBandwidthPackageSpec接口修改带宽包实例的带宽峰值

ModifyCenRouteMap.description_en: Modifies a routing policy of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
ModifyCenRouteMap.description_zh: 调用ModifyCenRouteMap接口修改路由策略

ModifyFlowLogAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and capture window of a flow log
ModifyFlowLogAttribute.description_zh: 编辑流日志的名称、描述以及捕获窗口时长

ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter.description_en: This operation modifies the payer for a cross-account network instance connection to a transit router
ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用ModifyGrantInstanceToTransitRouter接口编辑转发路由器实例连接跨账号网络实例的资费承担方

ModifyTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPo.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a stream classification rule
ModifyTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPo.description_zh: 编辑流分类规则的名称和描述

ModifyTransitRouterCidr.description_en: You can call the ModifyTransitRouterCidr operation to modify a CIDR block of a transit router
ModifyTransitRouterCidr.description_zh: 调用ModifyTransitRouterCidr接口修改转发路由器下的CIDR地址段

ModifyTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and feature options of a multicast domain
ModifyTransitRouterMulticastDomain.description_zh: 调用ModifyTransitRouterMulticastDomain接口修改组播域的名称、描述信息以及功能选项

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: You can call the MoveResourceGroup operation to move a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance or a bandwidth plan to a different resource group
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 调用MoveResourceGroup接口修改云企业网实例或带宽包实例所属的资源组

PublishRouteEntries.description_en: You can call the PublishRouteEntries operation to advertise routes from a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a virtual border router (VBR) to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance. If no route conflicts occur, other network instances attached to the CEN instance can learn the advertised routes
PublishRouteEntries.description_zh: 云企业网支持发布路由的功能。您可以将加载到云企业网中的VPC或VBR中的路由通过调用PublishRouteEntries接口发布到云企业网中，在没有路由冲突的情况下，云企业网中的其他网络实例可以学习到该路由

RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembe.description_en: Creates or adds a multicast member
RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembe.description_zh: 调用RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupMembers接口创建或添加组播成员

RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSourc.description_en: Use the RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources operation to create a multicast source. A multicast source enables one-to-many communication
RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSourc.description_zh: 为了实现一对多的组播通信，调用RegisterTransitRouterMulticastGroupSources接口创建组播源

RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarking.description_en: Deletes specified traffic classification rules from a traffic marking policy
RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarking.description_zh: 调用RemoveTrafficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingPolicy接口删除流量标记策略下的流分类规则

RemoveTraficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingP.description_en: Removes a traffic classification rule from a traffic marking policy
RemoveTraficMatchRuleFromTrafficMarkingP.description_zh: 删除流量标记策略下的流分类规则

ReplaceTransitRouterRouteTableAssociatio.description_en: Replaces the route table that is associated with a network instance connection
ReplaceTransitRouterRouteTableAssociatio.description_zh: 更换网络实例连接关联的转发路由器路由表

ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen.description_en: Connects an on-premises network to a cloud service
ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen.description_zh: 您可以通过调用ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen接口设置云服务，为本地网络添加访问云服务的配置

RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter.description_en: Revokes the permissions that a transit router has on network instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account
RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用RevokeInstanceFromTransitRouter接口取消转发路由器实例连接跨账号网络实例的权限

RoutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc.description_en: Call the RoutePrivateZoneInCenToVpc operation to configure the PrivateZone service

SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit.description_en: You can call the SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit operation to set, modify, or delete the inter-region bandwidth between two regions in a bandwidth plan for a Basic Edition transit router
SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit.description_zh: 调用SetCenInterRegionBandwidthLimit接口设置、修改或删除基础版转发路由器带宽包中两个地域间的跨地域互通带宽

TagResources.description_en: Creates and attaches tags to resources
TagResources.description_zh: 为资源创建并绑定标签

TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec.description_en: Temporarily upgrades a subscription bandwidth plan of Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec.description_zh: 调用TempUpgradeCenBandwidthPackageSpec接口对云企业网预付费带宽包实例临时升配

UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage.description_en: You can call the UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage operation to detach a bandwidth plan from a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance. After you detach the bandwidth plan, you can attach it to another CEN instance
UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 调用UnassociateCenBandwidthPackage接口解绑带宽包与云企业网实例之间的绑定，解绑后该带宽包可以绑定至其他云企业网实例

UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttr.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a quality of service (QoS) policy
UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttr.description_zh: 调用UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosPolicyAttribute接口修改流量调度策略的名称和描述信息

UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttri.description_en: Modifies the name, description, inter-region bandwidth, and Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value of a quality of service (QoS) queue
UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttri.description_zh: 调用UpdateCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueueAttribute接口修改流量调度策略下队列的名称、描述、跨地域带宽、DSCP值的配置

UpdateTrafficMarkingPolicyAttribute.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and traffic classification rules of a traffic marking policy
UpdateTrafficMarkingPolicyAttribute.description_zh: 调用UpdateTrafficMarkingPolicyAttribute接口修改流量标记策略的名称，描述信息以及流分类规则

UpdateTransitRouter.description_en: You can call the UpdateTransitRouter operation to modify the name and description of a TransitRouter instance
UpdateTransitRouter.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouter接口修改转发路由器实例的名称和描述信息

UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribut.description_en: Modifies the name and description of an ECR attachment for an Enterprise Edition Transit Router
UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterEcrAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下ECR连接的名称、描述信息

UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribu.description_en: Modifies an inter-region connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router
UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribu.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterPeerAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下跨地域连接的配置

UpdateTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a route in a route table of an Enterprise Edition transit router
UpdateTransitRouterRouteEntry.description_zh: 修改企业版转发路由器路由表中路由条目的名称和描述信息

UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable.description_en: You can call the UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable operation to modify the name and description of a route table for an Enterprise Edition transit router, or to enable or disable multi-region equal-cost multi-path (ECMP) routing
UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterRouteTable接口修改企业版转发路由器路由表的名称、描述信息和开启或关闭多地域等价路由

UpdateTransitRouterVbrAttachmentAttribut.description_en: Modifies the name, description, and automatic route advertising setting for a virtual border router (VBR) connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router
UpdateTransitRouterVbrAttachmentAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVbrAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下VBR连接的名称、描述信息、是否允许自动发布路由

UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribut.description_en: Modifies the name and description of a VPC connection on an Enterprise Edition transit router and to control automatic route advertising to the VPC
UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下VPC连接的名称和描述信息以及是否需要使企业版转发路由器自动发布路由到 VPC 实例

UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones.description_en: Modifies the zones and vSwitches that are associated with a virtual private cloud (VPC) connection
UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVpcAttachmentZones接口修改专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）连接关联的可用区和交换机

UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribut.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a VPN connection attached to an Enterprise Edition Transit Router. You can modify the connection's name, description, and automatic route publishing setting
UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribut.description_zh: 调用UpdateTransitRouterVpnAttachmentAttribute接口修改企业版转发路由器下VPN连接的名称、描述信息、是否允许自动发布路由

WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries.description_en: You can call the WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries operation to revoke routes published from a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) or Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance to Cloud Enterprise Network
WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries.description_zh: 调用WithdrawPublishedRouteEntries接口撤回专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）或边界路由器VBR（Virtual border router）实例已发布至云企业网的路由条目
